rule: per 4x4 px (~4 m) cell from slope_deg mean, roughness_m mean, 0.25 m ortho high-pass RMS (texture), ortho brightness (/p99), rock_density max. sand: slope<10 deg & tex<0.07 & rough<0.03 m & rockdens<0.01. bedrock (wins): slope>=16 deg OR (rough>0.04 & tex>0.09) OR (bright>0.75 & slope>10). else pebbly; sand with rockdens>=0.03 -> pebbly; 3x3 majority filter.
